name: Wisdom of the Coven (Coven)
body:
By pooling knowledge, covens can know more than the sum of their parts.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (any) 1 rank, coven member.

Benefit(s): You can assist your coven-mates on knowledge checks as long as you are able to speak. You may use aid another as an immediate action to aid your coven-mates with Knowledge checks, and the bonus you provide increases by +2 on a success.
